title: Chalmers proposes rules to allow super to invest in housing, energy, startups
paragraphs: Super funds will be allowed to invest 5 per cent of their portfolio in longer-term assets such as housing projects and venture capital, under a new proposal.
Funds would remain obligated to prioritise their members' best interests and will not be required to use the new option, or be directed towards any particular asset class.
It is unclear how many funds will use the new category.
